hero.title: Consume YouTube
hero.subtitle: Stop wasting hours on long videos. Utraya automatically summarizes your favorite channels so you stay informed in minutes, not hours.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Our AI engine works in the background so you never miss updates from the creators you follow.
howItWorks.step1Description: Add the YouTube channels you want to monitor by URL. We support all creators.
howItWorks.step2Description: As soon as a new video is published, our AI analyzes the content and extracts key points.
howItWorks.step3Description: Browse summaries in your dashboard. Understand 30-minute videos in just 60 seconds.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Our models are optimized for long-form video content and capture technical nuances, context, and speaker intent.
faq.q2: Can I get summaries in other languages?
faq.a2: Yes, Utraya supports multiple languages. Summaries are generated in your preferred language regardless of the video's audio language.
faq.q3: How many channels can I follow?
faq.a3: In V1 there are no limits to the number of channels you can follow.
faq.a4: We use enterprise-grade encryption. We never sell your viewing data or personal information to third parties.

cta.title: Ready to curate your intelligence?
cta.subtitle: Sign in with Google and start following your favorite channels right away.

cookies.title: Cookie preferences
cookies.description: We always use technical cookies. Analytics and measurement scripts are loaded only after your consent.

hero.subtitle: Utraya helps you follow YouTube channels and podcasts without watching or listening to everything. Get AI summaries in text and audio, save what matters, and organize content by topic.

problem.title: Too much content, not enough time.
problem.description: Videos saved for later, unfinished podcasts, channels publishing every day. Utraya helps you quickly decide what is worth your attention.

features.title: Core features
features.note: Multilingual support · Bring your own AI APIs

reuse.title: A processed content item can be useful more than once.
reuse.description: If content was already processed, Utraya can reuse the result instead of generating it again. This reduces duplication and keeps the service sustainable.
reuse.privacyNote: Your watchlist stays private. Utraya can reuse processing results but never exposes what you follow.

pricing.title: Free platform. Transparent when processing is needed.
pricing.description: Utraya is free to use. You can benefit from already processed content and connect your own AI APIs when you need a new processing run.

useCases.title: Use cases
useCases.item1: You follow many channels and cannot watch everything.
useCases.item2: You want to listen to a video summary while walking or driving.
useCases.item3: You want to decide if content deserves a deeper review.
useCases.item4: You want to organize videos and podcasts by topic.
useCases.item5: You want summaries in your preferred language.

faq.title: Short FAQ
faq.a1: Yes. Platform access is free and you can use already processed content.
faq.q2: Do I need my AI APIs?
faq.a2: No. They are needed only when you want a new processing not yet available.
faq.a3: Yes. Your choices stay private even when shared processing results are reused.
faq.a4: Audio summaries are coming soon and are clearly labeled as such.
faq.q5: Can I use Utraya in multiple languages?
faq.a5: Yes, Utraya is designed for multilingual usage.
faq.q6: What happens if content is already processed?
faq.a6: Utraya reuses available results to reduce duplication and waste.

finalCta.title: Take back control of the content you follow.

features.finalCtaTitle: Start from your watchlist and build your flow.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.freePlanDescription: Free access to the platform, private watchlist, content organization and use of already available processing.
pricing.apiBlockDescription: When you want a new AI processing for content not yet available, you can connect your own AI APIs.
pricing.keyMessageDescription: Utraya does not sell AI credit bundles. It lets you use what is already available and keeps generated processing under your control.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.q2: Do I need to provide APIs to use Utraya?
faq.a2: No. Without APIs you can still use already processed content.
faq.q3: When are my AI APIs required?
faq.a3: When you request a new processing run not yet available.
faq.a4: No, your personal API costs remain under your control.
faq.q5: What can I do without personal APIs?
faq.a5: You can follow content and use available processing.

faq.subtitle: Quick answers about access, APIs, privacy and fair usage limits.

mission.intro1: Utraya starts from a simple need: follow meaningful content while keeping control of your time.
mission.intro2: Every day new videos, podcasts and useful content are published, but available attention does not scale the same way.
mission.pillar1: Give users control back over their time.
mission.pillar3: Reuse existing processing in a sustainable way.
mission.pillar4: Keep privacy and personal choice at the center.

about.intro: Utraya is an independent personal project created for people who follow many YouTube channels and podcasts and want readable, listenable, organized summaries.
about.youtubeDescription: Utraya evolves continuously. Updates, features and product decisions will be shared on the YouTube channel.
